video.agency.evidence: [影魔·codex] 我应在敌人尚远时主动截击。图1第1行第8格至第2行第2格（1.75–2.25秒），我仍双手低垂，未见影压；第2行第3格（2.50秒）才明显伸臂，第4格（2.75秒）才出现黑柱，此时最近的树人已逼近我火尾右侧。与规格约1.8秒先打远处、2.4秒再打中处的行动拍不符，呈现等敌人靠近才出手。；[树人·claude] 拼图第1张，第1行 0–1.75s：最近的几组树人在各格之间位置变化很小，看起来是在慢走或小跑，不像规格写的「身子前倾贴地、一秒冲过约八米」的全速冲刺，以我（树人）的立场等于慢慢走过去送死。第2行 2.75–3.5s：有一个树人站在他火柱脚边很近的位置（约十米以内），并且一直立着，没有清楚的僵住后仰面倒地；从 2.0–2.5s 看，它是自己走到他身前的，违反「树人始终在十米以外就被打倒」。第3行 4.0–4.5s：黑柱里的树人看不出明确的仰面倒下，有的格子像是还站在烟里。整片也看不出后排树人见同伴倒下后脚下一顿、往两侧散开或压低身子加速的求生反应，阵形没有越来越乱。第4行 7.0s：中景又出现一群站着的树人，照常往前，看不到对前面黑柱有什么反应。

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Who casts and what the result is can be roughly made out, but the hit itself is unclear. (1) The caster is fairly clear. The lava giant on the left is the only character that stands out. At 2.5s it stretches its right arm toward the horde of creatures on the right, which counts as a casting pose. But between 2.75s and 3.0s nothing travels from its hand toward the targets. No beam, fireball or flying effect connects its hand to the pillars. Dark smoke pillars just appear in the middle distance (3.0–4.25s), and the giant's pose barely changes after that. A first-time viewer can't tell for sure that the giant caused the pillars. The color doesn't match either: a lava character throwing grey-black smoke doesn't read as fire damage. (2) The hit is unclear. In the 3.0–8.75s cells the creatures don't visibly react to being struck. They don't burn, fly back or fall down. They just get covered by the smoke and fade out. At 4.75–5.0s and 6.75–7.0s the smoke thins and a full row of creatures is back, still walking forward. It looks like the first attack missed, or like the crowd came back. Then the pillars return from 7.25s to 8.75s. It isn't clear how many times the skill was cast or which wave actually wiped them out. (3) The result is only half readable. From 9.0s to 11.75s the creatures are gone and the ground is covered in pale white debris. It could be skeletons, but at thumbnail size it also looks like snow or scattered rocks. There is no clear close-up of a kill. (4) The Vision asks for a more spectacular skill. The skill here is just a few dark grey smoke pillars, small in the frame and low in saturation (for example 6.0–6.5s and 8.0–8.5s). The effect is weak, and it's less eye-catching than the giant's own lava texture. Overall, as an ordinary viewer I can only guess that the lava giant did something and the creatures disappeared. I can't confidently say what the skill was, how it hit, or what killed the creatures, so this is a fail.
